ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. VIBHU BAKHRU, CHIEF JUSTICE)
1.

The petitioners have filed the present petition as a Public Interest Litigation, inter alia, seeking as under:
i. Issue a writ of Mandamus or any other writ, order or direction to the respondent authorities to cancel the license of the establishment of a bar and restaurant (pub)
named "Eagles Perch" at Property No. 370, 14th Cross. 8th Main, Sadashivanagar,
Bangalore immediately;
ii. Issue a writ of Mandamus or any other writ, order or direction to the respondent authorities not to give any No Objection Certificate/permission for starting the establishment of a bar and restaurant (pub) named "Eagles Perch" immediately; And iii. Issue any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper under the facts & circumstances of this case in the interest of justice and equity.
2.
It is the petitioners' case that the Pub/Bar named 'Eagle Perch' has been established in the premises bearing No.370, 14th Cross, 8th Main, Sadashivanagar, Bengaluru.

It is contended that the site owners have obtained CL - 9 licence under the Karnataka Excise (Sale of Indian made Foreign Liquuor) Rules, 1968 and NC: 2025:KHC:44652-DB HC-KAR under Section 13 of the Karnataka Excise Act, 1965.

entities.text: Karnataka Excise (Sale of Indian made Foreign Liquuor) Rules, 1968
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners' objection is that the said Pub/Bar is located at a distance less than 100 metres from a religious institution, which according to the petitioners is not permissible.
3. The respondents have filed statement of objections raising several objections.
4. First, it is contended that the writ petition is not maintainable as the licencee has not been made a party to the present petition and therefore, no order against the licencee can be passed.

5. Second, it is contended that no licence has been issued to respondent No.10 [Eagles Perch].
6.

It is stated that CL -9 licence had been issued in the name of Smt.S.Manjula at the licenced premises bearing property No.370, 14th Cross, 8th Main, Sadashivanagar, Bengaluru and the same licence has also been renewed in her name for the year 2025-26.
7.

It is stated that said Smt.Manjula had sought for shifting of the licence under Rule 23 of the Karnataka Excise (General conditions) Rules, 1967 during the Excise Year 2024-2025 and the same was shifted from 2/A, 100 feet road, Hosabinnamangala, Indiranagar, Bengaluru to the current address [No.370, 14th Cross, NC: 2025:KHC:44652-DB HC-KAR 8th Main, Sadashivanagar,
Sadashivanagar Residents Welfare ... vs State Of Karnataka on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172950846/
4 Bengaluru] by an order dated 04.06.2025.
8.

entities.text: Sadashivanagar Residents Welfare ... vs State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated that the said order of transfer has not been challenged.
Further, the concerned authority also is not made a party.
9. The objections raised by the respondent - State are merited.
10. Apparently, no order adverse to the licence holder can be passed without the licence holder being made a party to the petition.
11. In the aforesaid circumstances, the present petition is dismissed.
12. We leave it open to the petitioners to make a representation to the concerned authority.
Needless to say that if a representation is made, the same would be considered in accordance with law.
13. Pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.

Sd/-
(VIBHU BAKHRU) CHIEF JUSTICE Sd/-
